headline: Mexico deal lifts sales, special charges pressure GAAP EPS
summary_short: McCormick reported Q2 FY2026 net sales of $1,936.6M, up 16.7% y/y (+3.3% q/q) on the McCormick de Mexico acquisition and pricing, but diluted EPS fell to $0.56 from $0.65 a year ago on higher special charges.
summary_long: Net sales rose 16.7% y/y (+3.3% q/q) to $1,936.6M: the McCormick de Mexico acquisition added 12.3pts, pricing +2.2pts and currency +2.7pts, partly offset by unfavorable volume/mix (-0.5pts). Gross margin expanded 270bp to 40.2% on the acquisition, pricing, an IEEPA tariff refund and CCI cost savings, partly offset by higher commodity and Middle East conflict-related freight costs. Operating income grew 12.4% y/y to $276.4M (adjusted operating income +30.1% to $336.4M). Diluted EPS fell to $0.56 from $0.65 y/y as special transaction/integration charges tied to the pending Unilever Foods merger widened; adjusted diluted EPS rose to $0.80 from $0.69. FY2026 outlook: net sales growth of 13%-17%, adjusted operating income growth of 16%-20%, adjusted diluted EPS of $3.05-$3.13.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by the McCormick de Mexico acquisition (+12.3pts), favorable pricing (+2.2pts) and currency (+2.7pts), partly offset by unfavorable volume/mix (-0.5pts) from Consumer segment declines in the Americas.

Margin expanded 270bp to 40.2% on the Mexico acquisition, favorable pricing, an IEEPA tariff refund and CCI cost savings, partly offset by higher commodity costs and Middle East conflict-related freight costs.
SG&A rose 90bp of sales on the Mexico acquisition, higher brand marketing and technology investment, but was more than offset by the gross-margin gains described above.

Special charges of $60.0M (up from $12.8M a year ago), mostly Unilever Foods transaction and integration costs, cut diluted EPS by $0.24 versus $0.04 last year, outweighing higher adjusted operating income.

Two structural events shaped the quarter: the Jan-2026 consolidation of McCormick de Mexico (adds ~12% to sales) and the announced Reverse Morris Trust merger with Unilever Foods, which is adding transaction and financing costs.
